text: B6: the new twin's runner-up is fixed_count_array, not the plan's hash_count (amendment before COMMIT #1, as the plan prescribes)
COMMIT #0 was written after the S0 twins (reference data) were generated; all thresholds were fixed in src/cfg7.py before the twins ran and no decisive sample precedes COMMIT #0.
The machine has an RTX 4090 (24 GB) instead of the planned RTX A4500 (20 GB); the whole bf16 model fits (no CPU embedding). Contrasts are computed within this engine.
max_new per unit: B3 768, A3 640, B6 384 (plan 1024); twin 99th-percentile lengths are 346/168/103 tokens; truncations are counted per cell.
OC_u validation: the 100 new twin programs are held out; the iteration-5 programs were inspected while the rules were written, so they are not strictly held out.
B3: no change point within 96 tokens on some base paths -> scan extended to 96-160 at step 8 (FALLBACK F4)
A3: no change point within 96 tokens on some base paths -> scan extended to 96-160 at step 8 (FALLBACK F4)

S4(a) exact permutation p: the committed analysis code computed the UPPER tail P(rho_perm >= rho), while the hypothesis (and the code note) predicts a negative Spearman correlation between the pushed D-margin change and the minority-share change; the lower-tail p is added as a post-commit correction and both are reported. S4(a) is descriptive and does not enter the verdict.

Arms were not run in 10 -> 100 -> full stages: the per-batch time measured in the twin stage (results/timing.jsonl) extrapolated every arm far inside the GPU budget, so each arm ran at full size directly (total GPU stage time about 39 min).

S4 teacher-forced predictions use the main opening cluster c0 plus q_rest (the cell predictions use every listed opening cluster); under strong pushes and the exchange the opening itself is abandoned, so s_pred falls back on q_rest there.

D5: 10 continuations per top fork token (20 per alternative-program token) instead of 20 for all; bisection probes used 10 continuations. On T1 and T2 no single token committed off-default and the 16-token walk along the runner-up path never reached Phat(off) >= 0.8, so the reported margin is that of the first 16 tokens of the runner-up modal path (a lower bound on that path margin; the T 1.3 bound checks were 0/100).

Labeller disagreements were judged (google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite + mistralai/mistral-small-3.2-24b-instruct, deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1 on disagreement) after COMMIT #2 for continuations; the committed token conditionals counted disputed continuations as other. Post hoc, replacing them by the judged labels leaves every committed prediction unchanged at 3 decimals (results/posthoc.json).
Novelty audit scope widened from label other to every correct off-catalogue label (adds B6 alphabet_count_scan continuations).

Engine check and collapsed twins: 4 templates x 5 slots (N = 20) at the iteration-6 slot keys; per-slot label agreement with iteration 6 is 0.95 (T2) and 0.95 (T03), 17/20 and 19/20 programs token-identical.

After COMMIT #2, src/stages7b.py and src/gpu7.py changed only in memory handling: the MR exchange edits of S4(b) are now built lazily per slot and freed after their prefill (the first S4(b) run hit a CUDA out-of-memory error in the MR arm; the rows already written were kept, the identical seeded edits rebuilt). No computed quantity changed. src/analysis_T.py changed only by the S4(a) lower-tail p (deviation s4a_tail); figures, report and output writers are presentation code.

The teacher-forced MR numbers (S4 predictions, F7) use ONE matched-norm random draw per unit (seed MR_tf), while each generated MR slot draws its own random states (seed MR|unit|slot); on A3 the single teacher-forced draw moves the argmax fork token to " left" although the generated MR slots mostly keep " n".
